reviews.t: Obagi Serum shrinks puffiness and dark circles but Obagi cream is better for firming, elasticity and lines.
reviews.x: Better than Elastiderm Eye Cream for Puffiness and Dark Circles. I am a 38 yr old male.  I used the cream nightly before I bought this serum. With the cream I saw excellent results in terms of tightening/firming around the eyes and reduction in fine lines. However, I still had some slight puffiness and purplish dark circles until I bought this serum. The potent caffeine in this serum deflated the puffiness under both my eyes in 15 minutes and constricted the purple vein under my left eye so it w

I have been using this product for about 5 weeks on the advice of my dermotologist.  I have very large puffy sections under my eyes and didn't want surgery.  In 5 weeks, the puffy has been reduced in half and I am very happy.  I will be using this product from now on.  I asked the Dr why this product rather than the OTC offerings and he said this product has a far higher concentration of caffeine and antioxidants than allowed OTC which is why the results are much better.  It is not a miracle cur

I have used the serum for 1 month. I have seen no reduction in the puffiness under my eyes. I will use the remaining product but will not purchase any more. Disappointed in the results. Will notify my optimologist who recommended it. It was cheaper on amazon than thru her office but didn't work for me.

reviews.t: A beauty industry expert's professional opinion
reviews.x: Not all Obagi products are made at the same place -- but i found out that this formula is made by one of the top skincare labs in the US--one that manufactures high-end dermatologist and clinical skincare brands on the market today. So knowing this, i knew there would be *some* efficacy to this product. I actually LIKE that ingredients are straightforward and not full of fluff:  Water (Aqua), Dipropylene Glycol, Ethoxydiglycol, Caffeine, Malonic Acid, Zinc Carbonate, Arginine, Laureth-9, Copper

reviews.t: Best eye cream on the market
reviews.x: The Obagi eye cream is one of the best products on the market. I noticeably saw a decrease in the wrinkles around my eyes and am very happy with the product.
The fact that Obagi still tests on animals is pathetic and enough of a reason to never purchase this brand unless their cruelty practices are banned.

reviews.t: Still have bags and will travel on.
reviews.x: After reading the stellar reviews and researching online I decided to give this product a try.  Pro's: The roller ball releases the right amount of product and the cool serum feels really good.   No under eye tugging with the application. Con's: Expensive (but would have been worth the price if I saw results).   Did not reduce my under eye puffiness. I would recommend trying this product as a last resort, maybe it will work for you. reviews.t: Good product for depuffing and for sensitive eyes
reviews.x: Good product, reduces the stress and puffiness of "morning eyes." My eyes are extremely sensitive to most eye care products and I wear contacts, but this seems to work just fine. No itching or eyes watering, and it rolls right on. I use the La Mer Creme at night for wrinkles, but this is good for daytime

it will help somewhat w/puffiness, but frankly any rollerball anti-puff will, a cold ice pack would do the same. the reason I tried OBAGI was for the lightening aspect, as OBAGI products claims to do this very well. sadly I saw no lightening of under eye dark circles
I love Obagi but this was terrible. Dumb, expensive purchase on my part. Will continue to buy their other products. Don't buy this one!
I have used this almost everyday and have noticed no visible results. I am not that impressed. The Elastiderm gel works much better.

reviews.t: Long term benefits keep me hopeful!
reviews.x: I like it, but I am not totally sure it is doing much.  As I delve into the world of anti-aging skin products, I realize that most of these type of products are not necessarily going to make an immediate noticeable improvement, but they are more for the long-term slowing process.  I have only been using this product for a few weeks, so will continue to use it and will see how it works.  I do love the packaging and how this applies as a result.  It is cooling and nice.

reviews.t: See Improvement After Two Months Of Use
reviews.x: Love it.  I am 63.  It feels cool to the touch under your eyes and you can roll your eye-bags to disperse the fluid that accumulates overnight in this area.  Of course, this is not a miracle.  I don't think I look younger, but I feel the area under my eyes is firmer than before the use of this product.  I use this with another Obagi eye cream.  Together, I see improvement in my under eye area after nearly two months of use.

I received this product on time.  I have to use it every other night, as it burns my skin.  However, that being said, I have used it on one eye and another product on the other eye.  This product stands out.  It reduces my bags--which I am most concerned about.  it also fades the dark circles, though not as quickly apparent.

I love this. Goes on so easily and works to help remove fine lines around my eyes. I bought this a few weeks ago and am very impressed with the results.I have sagging bags above and below my eyes. Tried this stuff and it have reduced the bagginess.

From spouse of account holder.. I love this eye cream. I have been an avid OBAGI user for 15 years . This is so simple to use. Makes my eyes look brighter and softens the skin underneath my eyes. Lessens the dark circles too!!

This stuff really works! I am 32 and have a few crows feet starting and tired eyes. This literally banished my fine crows feet and makes my under eye area look much more youthful. I can't wait to try more of this brand.
Been using over a month, small improvement .Not sure I'd pay 90.00.That's the price elsewhere.I probably will try something else or go back to my previous cream.

reviews.t: Seems to be working for me in the short amount of time I've had it
reviews.x: My dermatologist recommended this brand and so I tried it for six weeks. Like the outcome so far for my dark circles. will purchase again, the roller is awesome!
I saw no benefit from this product but others that I know personally have seen great benefit. Oh well, can't work great for every one!
Save your $$$ I used this for over 6 months it is long lasting but saw 0 results
I really like the way this works with the Obagi Elastiderm Eye Cream.

claims.text: Many reviewers report reduced under-eye puffiness after using the serum.
Some reviewers saw no reduction in puffiness or dark circles even after weeks of use.
Several reviewers praise the rollerball applicator for releasing the right amount of product and feeling cooling without tugging.
A few reviewers find the product expensive, with some calling it a poor value.
One reviewer objects to the brand's animal testing practices.
